notes.title: 🐜 Embark in a journey through the infinitely small in Empire of the Ants 🐜
notes.content:
[b]Discover Tower Five's next game![/b]

Prepare to embark on a [b]fantastic journey through the infinitely small[/b] and [b]lead your colony to a hopeful horizon[/b] in [i][b]Empire of the Ants[/b][/i]!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/4057a1a7b35965ba84c6a3f251c1ef534a430be1.jpg[/img]

[h1]Take part in the exodus of a doomed and lost colony[/h1]

Based on Bernard Werber’s best seller, [i]Empire of the Ants[/i] 🐜 will offer a [b]strategic[/b] experience close to the iconic book saga.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/a44e78267485b18a026131572e064ecdd9e64800.jpg[/img]

Play as the [b]Ant Savior[/b], whose mission is to lead its “people” and rebuild a home, protect them, make them prosper and conquer new territories through different seasons.

Experience [b]immersive adventures[/b] and defend your lands through tactical and strategic battles in a [b]microscopic world of epic proportions[/b].

[b]Exploration, strategy, combat skills[/b] but most of all the [b]local wildlife alliance[/b] will be necessary in order to emerge victorious from the many challenges that await you.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/f5ac91181ee49ef0d7aa42942b41b789291ce72a.jpg[/img]

🐜 [b]Take part in an Epic Adventure[/b] - Take the role of a brave ant with a 3rd person view and explore unique abilities that can help you in battle and exploration

♟️ [b]A 3D Real-Time Strategy game with a progressive difficulty[/b] - The game promises an intuitive experience for newcomers, with the presence of tutorials to learn the fundamentals of RTS to help them get used to the game. At the same time, the game will offer a scalable difficulty and adaptable experience for veteran players who will discover new game mechanics as well as advanced strategies and combat skills

🏞️ [b]Explore gorgeous environments and meet the local wildlife[/b] - The game will feature a photo-realistic forest to explore. Meet and encounter other ants and forest dwellers through your adventure and interact with them

📸 [b]Photo-realistic[/b] - Unreal Engine 5 allows to push the boundaries of the photo-realistic effect on the plants and wildlife

🍂 [b]Narrative based on the seasons rhythm[/b] - The game features a narrative that follows the rhythm of the seasons, the environment and gameplay mechanics will adapt.

🌙 [b]Diversity of contrast and adaptation[/b] - The maps in the game will change based on the time of day (day, night, dawn, and twilight)

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/dc8cd66e7cdd9f702abca6e980689650a06271e5.jpg[/img]

[h1]Empire on the Ants is set to release in 2024[/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43519985/04d2a5d438711e0bd1875cb65f3a6f845a31381a.jpg[/img]

🐜 [b]Wishlist Empire of the Ants now[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2287330/Empire_of_the_Ants/

notes.title: Major Update - Definitive Edition
notes.content:
Dear players,

We're really glad to introduce a major update for Lornsword Winter Chronicle!
Here is the list of changes made to the game in order to improve the experience:

[b]1 - Graphics improvements[/b]

- Introduced dynamic lights
- Added ambient occlusion
- Increased available resolutions
- Better anti-aliasing
- Improved visual FXs

[b]2 - Core gameplay improvements[/b]

- [b]Added Minimap! [/b]
It greatly helps readability of the action and balances the easy and medium modes

- Added mine & farms flag control 
- The player now has to hold to demolish 
- Improved main character visibility 
- Upgrades don't heal anymore

[b]3 - AI improvements[/b]

- Reactivity is boosted 
- AI personality traits were reinforced 
- Deeper situation analysis from the AIs 
- Better AIs reactions: tower rush, defend position...

[b]4 - Tutorial & game onboarding improved[/b]

- Introduced "Learn by objectives" option 
- Texts skimming 
- Color helps 
- Improved Timings 
- Better balancing 

[b]5 - Visual improvements[/b]

- Redrawn in-game portraits 
- Better cinematics visuals: drawings, lightings flickering
- Improved text readability

[b]6 - Additional localizations[/b]

Lornsword Winter Chronicle is now available for the following languages:

- French
- German
- Russian
- Simplified Chinese
- Spanish

And many other improvements to make the game experience as smooth as possible.

Thank you for the continued support on Lornsword!

notes.title: Lornsword's Second Early Access update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34870209/1bf3a0dd5160090524d64033d208b298ffe305b8.png[/img]

[b]Dear defenders of the Empire ![/b]

Our second Early Access update is now live on steam!

For this update we’ve improved Corun and Eshee skills and the battle dynamics while re-balancing the economy.

Here’s the main list of changes:

[b]Improved swordplay:[/b]	 	 			                                                                                            
[list]
[*] Combo: 3rd attack deals additional damage
[*] New charged attack added
[*] Targets can now be staggered when being hit							[*] Impact and death visuals are clearer						                             [*] Corun and Eshee now damage enemies when using Void Walk through them
[/list]	

[b]Global pacing change: [/b]
[list]
[*] Troops are now bigger on screen and come in proper hands of 5 	 			                                                         [*] Hands under orange flag now synchronize their attacks 					              [*] Troop tiers and roles now have a greater influence on the fights 				                                   [*] Troops are now more reactive to your actions						                            [*] The economy dynamic has been sharpened 						                         [*] Mine usage has more importance
[/list]

[b]Quality of life improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Troops following you can be all released in one tap using the top right trigger
[*] Far Sight is now faster to use 				                                                                            [*] Prologue maps now give you a skip option to play the mission without the hand holding dialogues
[/list]

Do let us know what you think of this second patch on our Social Media channels:

- https://discord.gg/QkR3Png
- https://www.facebook.com/Lornsword
- https://twitter.com/lornsword
- https://www.instagram.com/lornsword_game/

notes.title: Lornsword's First Early Access update
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34870209/a227a5f49702688de9fd85a2f979ec74d9b167ba.png[/img]

Our very first Early Access update is now live on steam!

We’ve made quality of life improvements, visual upgrades and better keyboard bindings!

Here’s the main list of changes:

[list]
[*] [b]Campaign chapter selection added [/b](you liked the Nil Roga battle? You can now play it again!)
[*] [b]New music tracks added[/b]
[*] [b]Difficulty balancing improved[/b] (easy, normal and hard levels have been adjusted)
[*] [b]Alert icons made clearer[/b] (you shouldn’t miss them any more)
[*] [b]Shadows buildings visual improvements[/b]
[*] [b]Shadows units visual improvements[/b] (if you think a unit is new, it’s not, it’s just better looking!)
[*] [b]Artifact Shines are now unique[/b] (they glow in the dark!)
[*] [b]Music system improvement[/b]
[*] [b]Keyboard binding improvement[/b] (a highly demanded change)
[*] [b]Summoning is now a direct action[/b] (previously you had to hold the button to make it work)
[*] [b]Outpost visibility improved[/b] (grass, could potentially hide it before, not any more!)
[*] [b]Shadows headquarters now self destruct [/b](in chapter 2 only - careful with your units, they can be caught in that explosion!)
[/list]

Do let us know what you think of this patch on our Social Media channels:
